gaps.title: Slovenia approves FSD Supervised as 6th EU member — 28 days before Oct 6 bloc-wide vote
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Sixth national approval ahead of the October 6 TCMV vote; six approved countries still cover only ~9% of the 65% population threshold needed to pass

gaps.title: Tesla releases EU FSD safety evidence ahead of Oct 6 vote — all data closes before April 2026
gaps.whyItMightMatter: First public disclosure of the safety file underpinning Dutch RDW approval; data predates the European rollout it is meant to justify, which may weaken the October vote

gaps.title: HW3 Model S and X to receive FSD v14 Lite 'soon' — Ashok told Ryan McCaffrey at Cybercab launch
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Closes the last major HW3 gap in the v14 Lite rollout; S/X discontinued in May 2026 yet still awaiting the update that reached most other HW3 cars months ago

gaps.title: Cybertruck + Powerwall 3 integration goes live — extends home backup 3+ days, three years after promise
gaps.whyItMightMatter: First vehicle-plus-home-battery bidirectional integration of this scale; originally promised at Cybertruck launch Nov 2023; Powerwall 2 and Powerwall+ compatibility still pending later this year

gaps.title: Goldman Sachs holds Tesla Neutral at $360 as Musk claims Cybercab 5x faster to produce than conventional cars
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Goldman's analysis pins Cybercab's $0.05–$0.30/mile cost edge on lower vehicle cost, but flags software scalability as the swing factor; Musk's 5x production claim lacks a unit or context
